steps.label: Set SphereBoxCollision preset (box at rest, sphere incoming)
Precondition: no contacts before the sphere reaches the box
Precondition: box (body 1) starts at rest height y=0.5
Sphere crosses the gap and strikes the box (~0.8s)
Invariant: bodies remain after the strike
Let the scene continue to settle (~0.8s more)
Invariant: box stays near table height
Invariant: sphere stays near table height
